Small | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in using fluorination-assisted aqueous quenching to control cooling-induced defect chemistry, suppressing cation vacancies and structural reorganization while forming an in-situ fluorine-rich passivation layer. This bulk-surface cooperative strategy stabilizes oxygen redox, enabling enhanced structural reversibility, suppressed voltage decay, and long-term cycling stability in Li-rich layered oxide cathodes.

یک چارچوب پتانسیل یادگیری ماشین جهانی با تنظیم دقیق کم‌داده، پتانسیل الکترود Li را در الکترولیت‌های متنوع با دقت سطح ab initio محاسبه می‌کند.
Journal of the American Chemical Society | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in integrating a universal machine learning potential with data-efficient fine-tuning (~200 DFT calculations per electrolyte) to compute Li electrode potentials at ab initio accuracy, overcoming cluster-model and AIMD limitations. Its significance is enabling efficient, accurate prediction across diverse electrolytes and revealing mechanistic links between Li+ solvation environments and potential shifts, guiding rational electrolyte design for Li-metal batteries.
🏷 Li electrode potential · machine learning potential · battery electrolyte · fine-tuning · solvation structure

item.title: Scalable Upcycling of Industrial Waste Polytetrafluoroethylene Into Porous Carbon Nanosheets by Zeolite Particle Templates for Capacitive Energy Storage
item.description:

Angewandte Chemie International Edition | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in using zeolite-particle templates to catalytically cocarbonize PTFE waste into porous carbon nanosheets while fixing 81% fluorine as recyclable NaF. This overcomes PTFE's zero-residue pyrolysis, enabling scalable upcycling. Significance: exceptional dual-mode energy storage (429.6 F g⁻¹ supercapacitors; 267.0 mAh g⁻¹ zinc-ion batteries, −25°C operation) with validated industrial viability and low cost.
🏷 PTFE upcycling · porous carbon nanosheets · supercapacitor · zinc-ion battery · zeolite template
